description: This file defines API routes for managing investigator assignments within an insurance fraud detection platform. It includes endpoints for listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and queue management of assignments, integrating with a database layer (supabase) and leveraging FastAPI framework.

methods.name: list_assignments( investigator_id: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by investigator UUID"), status: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by assignment status"), claim_id: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by claim UUID"), limit: int = Query(50, ge=1, le=200), offset: int = Query(0, ge=0), )
methods.description: Retrieves a list of investigator assignments with optional filters for investigator, status, or claim.

methods.name: get_assignment(assignment_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches a specific assignment by its UUID.

methods.name: create_assignment(assignment: AssignmentCreate)
methods.description: Creates a new investigator assignment, updates claim status, and increments investigator workload.

methods.name: update_assignment(assignment_id: str, assignment: AssignmentUpdate)
methods.description: Updates fields of an existing assignment such as status or notes.

methods.name: get_investigator_queue(investigator_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves the current workload queue for a given investigator.

ctags.name: list_assignments
ctags.signature: ( investigator_id: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by investigator UUID"), status: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by assignment status"), claim_id: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter by claim UUID"), limit: int = Query(50, ge=1, le=200), offset: int = Query(0, ge=0), )
